paper_title: Searching for Axion-Like Particles with the Blazar Observations of MAGIC and Fermi-LAT
notes: Blazar ALP-photon oscillation search. Combined Mrk 421 (MAGIC+Fermi-LAT) 95% C.L. limit excludes g_agamma >~ 2e-11 GeV^-1 for 8e-9 eV <~ m_a <~ 2e-7 eV. Only the rough boundary values quoted in text are extractable; detailed exclusion contour is in Fig. 3/4 plots not numerically tabulated. Not a DM haloscope so no local density assumed. | Vision: Lower boundary of red exclusion contour (Mrk 421 MAGIC+Fermi-LAT combined, 95% C.L.) from Fig. 4. Excluded region extends to about g_agamma >~ 2e-11 GeV^-1 for 8e-9 to 2e-7 eV, consistent with abstract. The plateau near y~6.5e-11 corresponds to the CAST horizontal cutoff at top of red region. | Calibration: No calibration needed
